hero.headline: Harmonizing 24 Years of Satellite Fire Observations
hero.subheadline: FHI (Fire History Interface) unifies two decades of MODIS and VIIRS thermal records into a consistent historical series across Argentina, bridging the scale gap between orbital sensors.

challenge.title: The Challenge: Harmonization of MODIS and VIIRS Hot Spots
challenge.paragraph1: Since 2000, NASA's MODIS sensor has monitored thermal anomalies at 1 km resolution. In 2012, the VIIRS instrument introduced higher resolution observations at 375 m. Because a VIIRS pixel covers roughly one-seventh the area of a MODIS pixel, it detects three to four times more hot spots under the same fire conditions.
challenge.paragraph2: Comparing raw counts directly creates a false impression of an abrupt wildfire increase, when only the satellite sensor changed. Furthermore, a satellite hot spot is a thermal detection within an observation cell, not necessarily an individual fire.
challenge.scaleNote: A single MODIS observation cell contains approximately 7 VIIRS cells.

solution.title: Our Solution: FHI (Fire History Interface)
solution.paragraph1: We built FHI (Fire History Interface), an open interactive platform designed to explore satellite observations across Argentina, compare MODIS and VIIRS data, and analyze 24 years of fire activity on a unified scale.
solution.paragraph2: The system combines 3D geospatial visualization with a continuous monthly calendar matrix and statistical anomaly detection, differentiating directly observed data from pre-2012 estimates.
solution.caption: FHI observation system: 3D satellite visualization alongside the 24-year historical calendar matrix.

prediction.title: Companion Fire Prediction App
prediction.paragraph1: As a complement to FHI, our team developed an experimental fire prediction tool focused on forward-looking territorial risk assessment.
prediction.paragraph2: While the main platform provides the historical and harmonized baseline, the prediction app models environmental variables and territory vulnerability to help anticipate severe fire conditions.
prediction.caption: Companion prediction application: forward-looking territorial risk zoning and environmental indicators.
